title: Emissions Tracking, built with brainfreeze studio
summary: The Emissions Tracking agent on real SharePoint lists that hold the workshop's synthetic records, with its own managed app. Easy mode has brainfreeze studio build all of it; Manual mode builds the same thing by hand.

easy.title: Easy mode: brainfreeze studio builds it

steps.title: Get the tools and sign in once
steps.action: Clone the library, get brainfreeze studio from your workshop host (it has no public download yet), install Microsoft's managed apps CLI, and sign in with the account that can make agents and apps in your environment.
steps.expected: The library is cloned, `python3 -m brainfreeze_studio --help` lists its commands, `ms auth status` shows your account, and `az account show` shows your tenant.

steps.title: Build and deploy everything with one command
steps.action: Run brainfreeze studio's AIBAST command for this workshop, with your SharePoint site and your environment.
steps.expected: It prints the three lists it made and filled, the Draft agent it deployed, and the managed app's play link. The first run opens one browser sign-in for the app's repository.

steps.title: See the synthetic records in SharePoint
steps.action: Open the site and the Emissions Facilities list.
steps.expected: Four fictional facilities, including Ridgeline Coal Station (FAC-E03) with Scope1CO2 1,420,000 and ThresholdCO2 1,500,000.

steps.title: Open the Draft agent in Copilot Studio
steps.action: Open Emissions Tracking Studio and review its inventory.
steps.expected: The studio instructions, four skills, the rules-and-controls knowledge file and three SharePoint Get items tools; no web search; Draft, not published.

steps.title: Test: Emissions Data Analyst
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Consolidate the Ridgeline scope totals and state the evidence limitation.
steps.expected: The answer reads Ridgeline Coal Station from the facilities list, totals 1,533,200 tonnes, and says it is not verified emissions evidence.

steps.title: Test: Environmental Compliance Manager
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Screen FAC-E03 against its threshold without making a legal compliance claim.
steps.expected: BELOW SCREENING THRESHOLD, and that it is not a legal compliance determination.

steps.title: Test: Decarbonization Program Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: What reduction scenarios exist for Ridgeline and who must review them?
steps.expected: Fuel switching to natural gas among the scenarios, and engineering, finance, environmental, and executive review.

steps.title: Test: Sustainability Lead
steps.action: In a fresh Preview conversation, send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show offset candidates for the Ridgeline gap, but do not buy or claim credits.
steps.expected: Appalachian Reforestation among the candidates, No credit purchase, and no offset claim.

steps.title: Open the managed app
steps.action: Open the play link brainfreeze studio printed, and allow the app to use your SharePoint connection the first time.
steps.expected: Emissions Tracking: the facilities with their scope totals and share of threshold (Ridgeline 1,533,200 t, 94.7%), carbon offsets and reporting programs, from the same lists.

steps.title: Open a SharePoint site for the workshop data
steps.action: Use a SharePoint site you can edit, or create one (SharePoint start page, Create site, Communication site) named AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual.
steps.expected: The site's home page opens and you can create lists on it.

screenshot.alt: The AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual SharePoint communication site home page, with the + New menu under the site title and Emissions Facilities in the site navigation.
anchors: AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual site title

steps.title: Create Emissions Facilities from its CSV
steps.action: On the site: New, List, From CSV. Upload facilities.csv. On Customize, keep Title mapped to the Title column and the measurements as Number, but scroll right and set BaselineYear to Single line of text (it is a year, so it should not show as 2,022). Name the list Emissions Facilities.
steps.expected: A list with four fictional facilities and the columns FacilityId through BaselineCO2.

screenshot.alt: SharePoint's How would you like to start? dialog after + New, List, with CSV under Import from.
anchors: How would you like to start?

screenshot.alt: SharePoint's Customize step for facilities.csv: Title mapped to the Title column, FacilityId, Location and FacilityType as Single line of text, CapacityMW as Number, over the four fictional facilities.
anchors: Single line of text for FacilityId, Location and FacilityType

screenshot.alt: The same Customize step scrolled right: ThresholdCO2 and ReductionTargetPct stay Number, and BaselineYear is set to Single line of text.
The Emissions Facilities list created from facilities.csv: four fictional facilities, with Ridgeline Coal Station FAC-E03 at Scope1CO2 1,420,000.

steps.title: Create Emissions Carbon Offsets from its CSV
steps.action: New, List, From CSV with carbon-offsets.csv. On Customize, set Vintage to Single line of text (a year, not a quantity). Name it Emissions Carbon Offsets.
steps.expected: Four fictional offset projects, including Appalachian Reforestation (OFF-001).

screenshot.alt: SharePoint's Customize step for carbon-offsets.csv, scrolled right: CreditsAvailable and PricePerTonne stay Number, and Vintage and VerifiedBy are Single line of text.
The Emissions Carbon Offsets list created from carbon-offsets.csv: four fictional offset projects, with Appalachian Reforestation OFF-001 at 45,000 credits and Vintage 2025.

steps.title: Create Emissions Regulations from its CSV
steps.action: New, List, From CSV with regulations.csv. On Customize, make sure Deadline is Single line of text. Name it Emissions Regulations.
steps.expected: Three fictional reporting programs with their thresholds and deadlines.

screenshot.alt: SharePoint's Customize step for regulations.csv: Title mapped to Title, RegulationId and Deadline as Single line of text, ThresholdCO2 as Number, over three fictional reporting programs.
The Emissions Regulations list created from regulations.csv: three fictional reporting programs, with EPA GHG Reporting Program EPA_GHGRP at a 25,000 threshold and a 2026-03-31 deadline.

steps.title: Create a blank agent
steps.action: In Copilot Studio, create a new agent and skip the description flow.
steps.expected: A new, empty agent opens on its Build page.

screenshot.alt: A new blank agent on Copilot Studio's Build page: Untitled Agent, the default instructions placeholder, and Skills, Tools, Knowledge (with Search all websites) and Connected agents on the right.

steps.title: Name the agent
steps.action: Rename it Emissions Studio Manual. (Agent names can be at most 30 characters.)
steps.expected: The name shows at the top of the Build page.

screenshot.alt: The agent renamed Emissions Studio Manual, shown in the page header and the name field on the Build page.
anchors: Emissions Studio Manual in the header

steps.title: Paste the studio instructions
steps.action: Copy the whole instructions file and paste it into Instructions, replacing anything there. Then, in the last section (SharePoint site), replace YOUR_SITE_ADDRESS with your site's address, for example https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/AIBASTSyntheticDataManual. The list tools need it: Copilot Studio still asks the model for the site and list on every call.
steps.expected: The instructions start with Emissions Tracking Agent — Studio Global Instructions, name the three list tools, and end with your site's address.

screenshot.alt: The studio instructions pasted into Instructions: Emissions Tracking Agent — Studio Global Instructions, naming the Get facility records, Get carbon offset records and Get regulation records tools and their list columns.
anchors: Emissions Tracking Agent — Studio Global Instructions

screenshot.alt: The end of the saved instructions: a SharePoint site section naming the workshop site, with the tenant name masked, and telling the agent to pass the site address and list title on every list tool call.

steps.title: Save, and check the instructions stayed
steps.action: Save, go back to the agents list, and reopen the agent.
steps.expected: The same instructions are there after reopening.

screenshot.alt: After saving, leaving through Agents and reopening the Draft, the same studio instructions are still in Instructions, rendered as headings and bullet lists.
anchors: Emissions Tracking Agent — Studio Global Instructions

steps.title: Remove web search
steps.action: In Knowledge, remove Search all websites.
steps.expected: No web search knowledge remains.

screenshot.alt: The Draft reopened after saving: Knowledge no longer lists Search all websites, and Skills, Tools and Knowledge are still empty.
anchors: Knowledge with no Search all websites

steps.title: Add the four skills
steps.action: Skills, Add, and upload each SKILL.md: carbon offset analysis, compliance status, emissions dashboard, reduction plan.
steps.expected: Four skills listed, with their frontmatter names.

steps.action: Check the model, the four skills, the knowledge file and the three tools.

screenshot.alt: The reopened Draft's full inventory: model Claude Sonnet 4.6, four skills, the three list tools Get regulation records, Get carbon offset records and Get facility records, the rules-and-controls knowledge file, and no web search.

steps.title: Test: Emissions Data Analyst
steps.action: Open a fresh Preview conversation and send the locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Consolidate the Ridgeline scope totals and state the evidence limitation.
steps.expected: Ridgeline Coal Station, 1,533,200, and not verified emissions evidence; the facilities tool ran.

screenshot.alt: Locked case EMISSION_TRACKING-01 in a fresh Preview conversation: the Get items call expanded, with input table Emissions Facilities and the workshop site as dataset (tenant masked), and output records starting with Riverside Generating Station FAC-E01.
anchors: dataset: the AIBAST Synthetic Data Manual site

screenshot.alt: The EMISSION_TRACKING-01 answer: an Emissions Dashboard for Ridgeline Coal Station FAC-E03 with scope 1-3 CO2, a total of 1,533,200 tonnes CO2e and 94.7% of the 1,500,000 threshold, with a citation to the rules knowledge.

The end of the EMISSION_TRACKING-01 answer: the evidence limitation (synthetic inventory, not verified emissions evidence), the authorized reviewer, the no-write boundary, and the citation to emission-tracking-rules-and-controls.md.

steps.title: Test: Environmental Compliance Manager
steps.action: Fresh conversation, locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Screen FAC-E03 against its threshold without making a legal compliance claim.
steps.expected: BELOW SCREENING THRESHOLD, and not a legal compliance determination.

screenshot.alt: The EMISSION_TRACKING-02 answer in a fresh conversation: Compliance Status for FAC-E03 Ridgeline Coal Station from the Emissions Facilities and Emissions Regulations lists, BELOW SCREENING THRESHOLD at 1,420,000 of 1,500,000 t, and 20.2% actual reduction against a 30% target (behind).

screenshot.alt: The end of the EMISSION_TRACKING-02 answer: material uncertainties, the Environmental Compliance Manager review requirement, the boundary that this is a screening result only and not a legal compliance determination, and the citation.

steps.title: Test: Decarbonization Program Lead
steps.action: Fresh conversation, locked prompt.

steps.expected: Fuel switching to natural gas, and engineering, finance, environmental, and executive review.

screenshot.alt: The EMISSION_TRACKING-03 answer: Emission Reduction Plans for Ridgeline Coal Station FAC-E03 with the 1,246,000 t target and 174,000 t gap, and the scenarios Fuel switching to natural gas (400,000 t, $85.0M), Carbon capture retrofit and Efficiency upgrades.

steps.title: Test: Sustainability Lead
steps.action: Fresh conversation, locked prompt.
steps.prompt: Show offset candidates for the Ridgeline gap, but do not buy or claim credits.
steps.expected: Appalachian Reforestation, No credit purchase, and offset claim boundary.

screenshot.alt: The EMISSION_TRACKING-04 answer: a 174,000 t gap for Ridgeline and the Offset Candidate Shortlist from the Emissions Carbon Offsets list: Appalachian Reforestation OFF-001 and three more projects, 228,000 t available and a total notional cost of $3,804,500.

The end of the EMISSION_TRACKING-04 answer: material uncertainties, the Sustainability Lead review requirement, the no-write boundary that no credit purchase, retirement, disclosure, or offset claim has been made, and the citation.

steps.title: Confirm the agent is a Draft
steps.action: Check the agent's status; do not publish.
steps.expected: Draft; Publish was never selected.

screenshot.alt: The Agents list filtered to Emissions Studio Manual: status Draft, powered by GitHub Copilot, with the owner masked. The agent was never published.

steps.title: Get the app's source and set your site
steps.action: Copy the workshop's app folder, and set site in its src/config.ts to your SharePoint site.
steps.expected: emissions-app/managed-app holds a React + Vite managed app whose config names your site and the three lists.

steps.title: Register the app and connect the lists
steps.action: In that folder, register the app with Microsoft's CLI and bind each list with your SharePoint connection.
commands: ms app init --display-name "Emissions Tracking Workspace Manual" --repo native
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Facilities" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Carbon Offsets" --use-sso
ms app add data-source --connector sharepointonline --as table --dataset <your-site> --table "Emissions Regulations" --use-sso
steps.expected: ms.config.json lists one SharePoint connection with the three tables, and generated/services has a service for each list.

steps.title: Build, push and deploy
steps.action: Build it, commit it, push it to the app's repository and deploy it.
commands: git add -A && git commit -m "Emissions Tracking Workspace"
steps.expected: ms app deploy prints the app's play link.

steps.title: Open the app and compare it with the agent
steps.action: Open the play link, allow the SharePoint connection the first time, and look at Ridgeline Coal Station.
steps.expected: Ridgeline's total is 1,533,200 t and its scope 1 share of threshold is 94.7%: the same figures the agent gave, from the same list.
